ck: kartrtvasya putikatitatve prakrtyatikarananuvyakyanavirotanasankaya sanatanaparasutasayavarnanapurvakan karnanirnayaprasankasya vEsanyapratarsanan atapi syat “apatanataya visvakartrtvan putipurvakan uktan palavisakayan i prahnatarke ca satarani”ti prakrtyatikaraniyanuvyakyane kartrtvan putipurvakatvena visesitan tena kartrtvan putyakatitaniti sityatiti na syat sutEva sanatata yata suta- “tatapi putipurvakaniti vyartan karturputinatvaniyanatiti nEvan asesavisesacnanasya vivaksitatvatiti ayanasaya yatyapi kartrtvantarkatataya putinatvanalapi tatapi na kulalatisataranan sananyacnananeva pakavati, kintvasesavisesacnananapi pakavantanalankarotiti cnapayitun putipurvakaniti visesanan vyartan satkincicnapayatiti nyayat tata ca kulalativilaksanan pakavato cakatkartrtvan nirupayitun tatra visesanan sartakaniti nacatrapi tatEvastviti vacyan nirkunatanirakrterevatra prastavat sananyacnanakatitakartrtvasitavapi nirkunatvan palayate hi …. putisitantu na tatasatiti tatacacetano putavanalikitan karotiti na sakyan sanpavayituniti pava ….
s: कर्तृत्वस्य बुद्धिघटितत्वे प्रकृत्यधिकरणानुव्याख्यानविरोधमाशङ्कय समाधानपरसुधाशयवर्णनपूर्वकं कर्मनिर्णयप्रसङ्गस्य वैषम्यप्रदर्शनम् अथापि स्या
